groups.name: Manifestations of Staph aureus
groups.explanation: Bullous impetigo, tricuspid valve endocarditis, osteomyelitis, and a gram stain can all point to Staphylococcus aureus.

groups.name: Simple columnar epithelium
groups.explanation: The four clues point toward simple columnar epithelium in histology, organ identification, or gross anatomy.

groups.name: Multiple myeloma CRAB symptoms
groups.explanation: CRAB points to hyperCalcemia, Renal involvement, Anemia, and Bone lesions. Apple-green birefringence adds the amyloid clue associated with renal disease.

groups.name: Angelman Syndrome
groups.explanation: These written clues point to Angelman syndrome: a neurodevelopmental disorder associated with maternal UBE3A dysfunction on chromosome 15.

info.title: Bullous impetigo
info.text: Histology clue: a superficial intraepidermal blister.

info.title: Tricuspid valve endocarditis
info.text: Echocardiogram clue: a vegetation on the tricuspid valve.

info.title: Gram stain
info.text: Microscopy clue: gram-positive cocci in clusters.

info.title: Excretory ducts
info.text: Histology clue: simple columnar epithelium in an excretory duct.

info.title: Gallbladder
info.text: The gallbladder is removed during a cholecystectomy.

info.title: Small bowel
info.text: Histology clue: simple columnar epithelium in the small bowel.

info.title: Blood smear of anemia
info.text: The A in the CRAB mnemonic: anemia.

info.title: Hypercalcemia
info.text: The C in the CRAB mnemonic.

info.title: Apple Green Birefringence
info.text: Congo red amyloid under polarized light, associated here with renal involvement.

info.title: Lytic Bone Lesions
info.text: X-ray clue: lytic bone lesions, the B in CRAB.

info.title: Fascination with water
info.text: Behavioral clue: an unusual attraction to water, a hallmark of Angelman syndrome.

info.title: UBE3A
info.text: Gene clue: UBE3A, the maternally expressed gene on chromosome 15 lost in Angelman syndrome.

info.title: Chromosome 15
info.text: Genetics clue: Angelman syndrome maps to a deletion on the long arm of chromosome 15 (15q11-q13).

info.title: Wide-spaced teeth
info.text: Widely spaced upper teeth, a characteristic oral finding of Angelman syndrome.
